goal: We are launching the marketing site for Millwright, a B2B AI workflow company for discrete manufacturing. We sell to plant operations, quality and maintenance leaders at mid-size manufacturers who are running production on whiteboards, paper travellers and three disconnected systems. The site has to explain, without hype, that Millwright puts machine data, work orders, standard work and quality checks on one running plan that updates while the line is still moving — and it has to end every page by asking the reader to book a plant walkthrough with our team.
category: AI workflow automation for discrete manufacturing
audience: operations, quality and maintenance leaders at mid-size discrete manufacturers running one to five plants
positioning: the shop-floor workflow layer that keeps machine data, work orders and quality checks on one running plan

facts.value: Signal: streams machine, PLC and sensor data into one timeline the whole plant reads

Handoff: carries the open issues across the shift change instead of losing them
Ledger: keeps the build record for every serial, ready for an audit
Cell: models each line, station and asset so the plan matches the floor

Millwright was founded in 2021 by a plant engineer and a controls integrator, and the company is based in Ulsan, South Korea.
Millwright is certified to ISO 27001 for its cloud platform, and the certificate is available on request.
A typical Millwright deployment is commissioned on the first line in six weeks, including the machine connections.
